captures.file: public page, read 10 November 2026 by the curator (not a vault capture)
captures.what_is_new: The government declares a situation of alert for all mainland Portugal from 00:00 to 23:59 on 11 Nov 2026. Measures include: closure of schools and non-essential public services; suspension of outdoor events 'independentemente da sua natureza'; temporary ban on circulation and stay in parks, gardens and wooded areas judged at high risk; safety measures for temporary structures and hanging elements; temporary ban on circulation and stay by the shoreline, watercourses, riverside and flood-prone areas. It cites IPMA's gusts up to 120 km/h and, if a 'sting jet' forms, above 150 km/h.

story_candidates.title: Wednesday's alert: what the government has closed across Portugal
story_candidates.angle: The government's situation of alert covers all mainland Portugal on Wed 11 Nov: schools and non-essential public services closed, outdoor events suspended whatever their nature, parks and the waterfront off limits where risk is high. With IPMA's red wind in eight districts, a plain list of what the measures say, for readers and visitors.
story_candidates.note: Ready; time-sensitive. For journalist (summit desk); may be written as an update to S41 if the reviewer prefers. Conditions: quote the measures as the declaration words them; do NOT say whether the outdoor-events measure touches any part of Web Summit (no official source answers it; say so); the 150 km/h figure is conditional on a 'sting jet' forming; say the measures apply on 11 Nov only; link S41; no advice beyond the declaration and civil protection.
